:::{#sol-epe-reducible-sources}

A better method can reduce the squared [bias](#def-prediction-bias) and the [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) of $\predvalf{\predvar}$,
because both depend on how $\fitproc$ is built.
It cannot reduce $\varpar$,
which is the variance of the [noise](#def-noise) $\noise$ in the new outcome.

:::
